description: Reviewed facsimile repairs for the 2026-10-13 Tomi I-III and Tomus VI gap/split/skew work. Each `repairs` record pins one source-scoped fix identified by `disposition`: a `mask` whitens a Greek/Latin divider or scan-edge streak so the Latin column bands normally; a `shear` straightens a uniformly tilted scan with an integer per-column vertical shift before banding; a `whole_strip` wraps a reviewed cut-point strip whole instead of letting the composer fill-split it across a page break; a `word_patch` restores real source pixels of a glyph the crop dropped; and `source_spacing_retained` records a genuine gap that is left unchanged. Every record carries source identity, raw dimensions, and reviewed Latin regions that must survive byte-identically. Mask coordinates are normalized full-source fractions matching SOURCE_FURNITURE_MASKS unless `coordinate_space` is `sheared`; shear records carry the raw fingerprint, matched gap rows, `x0_px`, `baseline_slope`, shift range, and padding; whole-strip records carry the cropped column dimensions, the exact band, and the strip fingerprint. The top-level `diagnoses` array is measurement-phase evidence only and is not installed: only `repairs` records drive production.

diagnoses.baseline_symptom: III. Ceterum chapter opening is displaced and left-gutter fragments appear.
diagnoses.evidence: Matched gaps descend right; crop bands merge [907,2633], and the divider overlaps glyphs. Straighten before banding; remeasure crop and body filtering after shear.

diagnoses.baseline_symptom: Inflated gap after sed propter victoriam and Greek fragments in left margin.
diagnoses.evidence: Matched gaps descend right; production crop reaches the raw right edge and merges body lines into two giant bands. Straighten before crop and banding.

diagnoses.baseline_symptom: Reported quidem page straddle is absent in current PDF: p86 has the complete quidem passus Callisthenem line and p87 starts Alexander statim.
diagnoses.evidence: The source line is intact and the current reader break falls after the complete quidem line. A Tall strip alone does not justify a whole-strip entry or a word patch; first reproduce an actual mid-line split if this symptom returns.

diagnoses.baseline_symptom: Right crop clips endings of sive, praeter, (3), auferro, and idem; Greek bleeds left.
diagnoses.evidence: Matched gaps rise right; the baseline crop ends at x1708 while sive reaches x1720. Shear may change the detected crop; check every right glyph after shear before considering a source-pixel word patch.

diagnoses.baseline_symptom: consi- ends reader p394; lioque continues on p395 although both lines are adjacent in source p398.
diagnoses.evidence: The source consi-/lioque inter-line gap is 20 px at x [950,1050) and 18 px at x [1550,1650). The 815-px Tall strip spans both lines, fits a full 1394-px page after scaling, and its fill-split places them on reader pp394-395. Wrapping the reviewed strip whole is indicated; no source gap needs removal.
